name: CPlanTeam Editorial Calendar — AI Content Generator & Planner
author: CPlanTeam

sections.description:
CPlanTeam Content Planner with AI is a full-featured content calendar and AI generator for WordPress. Use it as your central planner to map storylines, assign dates, and see every idea on a timeline—then create drafts when you are ready. Whether you run a blog, a business site, or a multi-author hub, the plugin keeps your pipeline organized so you publish consistently without spreadsheet chaos.

Why teams use it

  • One source of truth – Your schedule lives in WordPress: titles, structures, keywords, and publish dates stay synced with real posts.
  • Calendar and list views – Switch between a table and a visual calendar—the classic layout—to spot gaps and busy weeks at a glance.
  • AI-assisted planning – Generate a batch of ideas mapped to your goals (Traffic, Leads, Authority) and drop them straight onto your timeline.
  • From idea to published post – Open any plan item and generate a complete draft in one click; background tasks keep the admin responsive while AI works.

What You Can Do (Free)

  • Plan and schedule – Create content ideas with titles, structures, keywords, and dates; adjust the lineup as priorities change.
  • Generate AI content plans – Let AI suggest a full plan aligned with your goals and preferences.
  • Generate full posts from plan items – Turn any entry into a WordPress post without leaving the planner.
  • View in Table or Calendar – The calendar shows your schedule visually; table view suits bulk edits and filters.
  • Manage everything in one place – Edit, reschedule, bulk delete, and track drafts, scheduled, and published work from the same dashboard.
  • Track usage – See your AI token balance and renewal date in the dashboard.
  • Background tasks – Generation runs in the background, so you can keep planning while AI creates content.

How It Works

  1. Activate the plugin—no complex setup.
  2. Complete onboarding – Choose your content goal, language, and optional recommendations.
  3. Opt in when prompted to enable AI features (optional but recommended).
  4. Add ideas manually or click Generate AI to populate your pipeline.
  5. Generate posts from any item when you are ready to publish.

Our Own API

Content Planner uses our own dedicated API hosted at api.contentplan.app for AI generation, usage tracking, and content moderation. Your data is handled securely and in line with our privacy policy. The plugin communicates with this API only when you use AI features.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: 20 AI tokens per 30 days, enough to try the full workflow and generate several posts.
  • Pro: 300 AI tokens per 30 days for heavier daily production.

Perfect For

  • Editors and bloggers who want a shared schedule inside WordPress
  • Small businesses planning campaigns on a visible timeline
  • Teams coordinating writers from one planner
  • Anyone who wants AI help without leaving their drafts and calendar

Documentation

A full User Guide for site admins and editors is available in the plugin: docs/USER-GUIDE.md

External services

This plugin connects to the CPlanTeam Content Plan API (api.contentplan.app) to provide AI-powered content generation, usage tracking, and related services. It is needed to generate content plans and full posts from plan items.

It sends prompts, topic inputs, content plan requests, and article generation inputs when you use AI features. AI functionality is disabled by default and activated only after explicit user opt-in (required for consent under data protection laws before transmitting data). Prompts are not logged. Generated outputs are stored server-side. Technical data (website domain, plugin version, license key, usage metadata) may be sent for license validation and plan limit enforcement.

This service is provided by 0N3 LAB Sp. z o.o.: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/content-plan directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open AI Planner in your admin menu to start planning.
  4. Follow the onboarding steps to set your goals and create your first content plan.

No database setup or configuration is required—the plugin creates its tables automatically.
sections.faq:
Is this an editorial calendar plugin for WordPress?

Yes. You get calendar and table views, dated plan items, and optional AI drafts from each entry—an editorial-style workflow without leaving the admin.

How is this different from a spreadsheet?

Your schedule stays tied to real WordPress posts and statuses. You see everything in calendar view, edit in bulk, and generate content without exporting to another app.

Does this plugin require any special configuration?

No. CPlanTeam Content Planner with AI works out of the box after activation. You can start planning and generating content immediately.

What PHP version is required?

PHP 7.4 or higher is required.

Do I need to opt in for the plugin to work?

The plugin works without opting in, but AI features (content plan generation and post generation) require opt-in. You can still create and manage plans manually without opting in.

How many AI generations do I get for free?

Free users receive 20 AI tokens per 30 days. Tokens are used when generating content plans and when generating posts from plan items. Your usage and renewal date are shown in the dashboard.

Where is the API hosted?

CPlanTeam Content Planner with AI uses our own API at api.contentplan.app for AI generation and related services.

What if I run out of tokens?

Tokens reset on your renewal date (shown in the Usage box). You can also upgrade to Pro for 300 tokens per 30 days.

Can I use my own editor (Gutenberg, Elementor, Classic)?

Yes. In Settings, you can choose Auto (detect your editor), Gutenberg, Elementor, or Classic for how generated posts are saved.
